title: Renaming the unused default term keeps it the default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, the shop's default for new customers and held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Choose a new name for it, term B, that no term has.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Replace the Name with the name of term B.
  4. Click "Save Changes".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens and "Edit" is available.

Step 2:

  • The "Edit Credit Term" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The Name reads term B.

Step 4:

  • The window closes, the toast "term B saved" shows, and the row now reads term B with the "Default" tag still on it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-E1: “Editing the name of an unused term that is the current default keeps it the default under its new name.”
  • S2-R4: “"Edit" opens the "Edit Credit Term" window (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) filled with the term's name, kind and days.”
